newsitem.title: USA: Arbor Health adopts shr holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Arbor Health adopts shr holder rights plan.

text.p: Arbor Health Care Co said Wednesday it adopted a stockholder rights agreement to assure that all Arbor stockholders are treated fairly in the event of a coercive takeover attempt.
Under the plan, shareholders will receive one right for each outstanding share of Arbor common stock, the company said.
The rights will attach on November 21, 1996, to stockholders of record on November 14, 1996. The rights will expire on November 14, 2006, the company said.

Arbor Chief Executive Pier Borra said the move "is not in response to any pending or anticipated takeover threat to the company, but rather as a measure to ensure fair and equal treatment for all Arbor shareholders in the event that an unfriendly or unfair offer is made for the company."

The company said the rights protect Arbor stockholders by giving the board a mechanism by which the directors could force a potential acquiror to propose an adequate and fair price in any takeover attempt.
